lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The armory door has not moved in a hundred and seventeen years. It moves now. Rifles, powder, and, at the back, a rack of hand-forged blades from the founding, still oiled.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: That is my crew's steel. Ash Camp forge marks. They will be here by morning if the Captain sends the signal.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Signal sent. Whatever you are, Auditor, you were the right thing to come up those stairs.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Something is wrong. The Wardens are not in the valley. Listen. They are inside the walls.
